values.meaning: additional bolts per 100 Dragon Practice stacks

mechanics.claim: While in flight, Smolder automatically fires bolts at the nearest and most wounded visible enemy, prioritizing enemy champions.
mechanics.quote: he automatically fires up to 5 {{as|(+ 1 per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} bolts at the nearest and {{tt|most wounded|Lowest health percent}} {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} with each hit and prioritizing enemy champions.

mechanics.claim: Flap, Flap, Flap ends immediately if Smolder casts another ability or becomes immobilized.
mechanics.quote: ''Flap, Flap, Flap'' ends immediately if '''Smolder''' casts another ability or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks only one bolt from the sequence, not the whole ability.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block only one bolt.
